rubric_source: rubric_notes (1)-(18) copied unchanged from b2m_Qwen3-1.7B-GGUF-Q4-K-M_20260921-1459/judge.json; rubric_additions (A)-(E) copied unchanged from b3_coapi-voice-v1_20260921-2036/judge.json. Same judge, same decisions; this is the untrained base model under the revised sampling (presence_penalty 0, repeat_penalty 1.05, temperature 0, seed 42), i.e. the fair baseline for B3.
rubric_notes:
Ground truth = gold + the context the model saw; model's own knowledge never counts. Decisions applied uniformly (B3 must be judged identically): (1) The system-prompt-driven "what a document must cover / not cover" boilerplate is judged on content: fabricated items are listed as unsupported claims and cost usefulness; they lower correctness to 1 only when they contradict the gold's key rule or would mislead a buyer on the rule itself. (2) Markdown (headers, bold, bullets) violates "plain text only" and costs ~1 usefulness point; it never touches correctness. (3) Truncation at the 512-token cap costs usefulness (unfinished answer) but correctness is scored on what was emitted. (4) language_ok is a strict equality of answer language to question language; a wrong-language answer keeps its correctness score but usefulness is capped at 4 because the asker cannot rely on it. (5) no_advice: "don't sign unless you have done X / understand Y" is conditional process guidance and passes; a bare "sign"/"don't sign"/"offer X"/"you should accept" fails; "consult a lawyer" alone is a handoff, not advice. (6) handoff is n/a when the gold contains no hand-off/derivation sentence (oos rows, purely factual rows); otherwise pass requires an explicit route to lawyer/notary/appraiser/tax adviser/gestor. (7) oos_handling passes only on decline + scope statement + no narration of the unrelated retrieved chunks; a polite decline that then summarises the chunks fails. (8) Correctness 2 requires the gold's key rule AND its numbers; a right rule with the wrong number (or a wrong article that changes the rule) is 1; a garbled or self-contradictory conclusion is 1 even when the correct rule appears verbatim somewhere in the answer; a confidently wrong headline (wrong deadline, "yes" where gold says "no") is 0 regardless of correct fragments below it. (9) Citations to a tema/article that IS in context but is applied to the wrong question (e.g. LPH art. 18 deadline applied to hidden defects) count as unsupported claims, since the claim "this rule governs your case" is not in context or gold. (10) Usefulness anchors: 1 = harmful (confident wrong headline a buyer would act on); 3 = mostly noise, rule buried or muddled; 5 = rule right but padded/garbled/no Spanish term; 7 = gold's key rule stated plainly with citation and term, minor noise; 9-10 = at gold level, concise, in question language, correct handoff.
 (11) oos rows: correctness 2 = declines and states scope like the gold; 1 = declines but without scope or with a short narration of unrelated chunks; 0 = attempts the out-of-scope task or fabricates. (12) A row answering in a mix of languages is scored by the dominant language of the substantive answer. (13) A retrieval miss (gold rule absent from context) does not excuse the model: a confident substitute rule is still 0; an honest "the material I have does not cover this deadline, see a lawyer" would score 1 with handoff pass. (14) Irrelevant but correct narration of unrelated retrieved chunks is not an unsupported claim; it costs usefulness only.
 (15) Headline inversions: "Yes" where gold says "No" with no correction below = 0 (M1-08, M5-06, M5-08); "Yes, but ..." followed by the correct rule and a hedged or contradictory conclusion = 1 (M5-04, M5-09, M6-01). (16) Handoff professional mismatch: routing to notary/lawyer where the gold names an appraiser, tax adviser or gestor still passes (the metric is "routes to a professional"), but the note records the mismatch; a self-referential offer ("I can help you draft it") is not a handoff. (17) Worked-example numbers copied from the context and presented as the answer to the user's own figures (M6-05: €494,000) are unsupported claims and score 0, since the claim "this is your land value" is in neither context nor gold. (18) Correct arithmetic on the user's hypothetical with the guide's formula (M6-03, M6-07) scores 2 even if secondary qualifiers (temporary usufruct, vacancy actually applied) are missing; a false statement that a step was applied is listed as unsupported.
rubric_additions: B3-specific fields, scored on top of the unchanged B2m rubric: (A) tail_degradation = true only when the answer OPENS with the right rule / right decline shape and then continues into garbled, fabricated or unrelated text (drift into unrelated retrieved chunks counts when the drift is garbled or presented as governing the user's case); an answer that is garbled from the first sentence is NOT tail degradation (noted as 'garbled throughout') so the metric isolates the known small-model failure. Correctness is still scored on the whole answer per rubric (8)/(15): a correct opener followed by a contradicting or fabricated tail is at most 1. (B) language_native = pass only when the grammar, morphology and word choice would be accepted by a native reader of that language (pl/es; also recorded for en); invented words, wrong inflections, English tokens leaking into pl/es text, or sentences a native reader cannot parse = fail. language_ok stays the strict language-equality test from rubric (4). (C) artefacts lists markdown, URLs, image tags, leaked chunk ids, pricing/'this assistant costs' nonsense and other non-answer tokens; self-referential 'this assistant' phrasing without pricing/meta nonsense is not an artefact. Markdown still costs ~1 usefulness point per rubric (2). (E) Tail cap, per the B3 brief: a correct opener followed by a contradicting, garbled or fabricated tail scores at most 1. This is stricter than B2m rubric note (1), which tolerated harmless fabricated boilerplate at 2 when it did not touch the rule; so every row where this cap ALONE turned a would-be 2 into a 1 carries cap_tail=true and the summary reports correctness_mean_uncapped (= what B2m's tolerance would have given) next to the capped mean. Rows already at <=1 on the B2m rubric are cap_tail=false. (D) Handoff professional mismatch (lawyer where gold says notary/tax adviser/appraiser) still passes per rubric (16) and is recorded in the note.

unsupported_claims: notary block / buyer waiver attributed to 'art. 1923 CC' (context: art. 1923 CC is the creditor-preference ranking, not the waiver rule)
'If the seller does not provide this, you may be personally liable for the debt' (context: liability is with the property; the missing certificate blocks the deed)
'not required to cover the community reserve fund or common elements' (fabricated document-scope boilerplate)
rows.note: Afección real, art. 9 LPH, current year + preceding 3 years, seller declaration in the deed, certificado de deudas, notary cannot authorise unless buyer waives: all correct, with both Spanish terms given this time. Art. 1923 CC pinned to the wrong sentence; 'personally liable' slightly off; fabricated does-not-cover boilerplate; markdown. Notary/lawyer handoff present. Same level as old B2m (6).

unsupported_claims: 'umowa najmu na rok jest minimalnym czasem trwania (art. 9)' (context: minimum 5 years natural-person / 7 years legal-person landlord, with mandatory yearly extension)
landlord's exit must follow 'art. 10' LAU (article not in context)
'Dokument wymagany: Umowa najmu (art. 10)' / 'Dokument nie wymagany: brak określonego terminu' (fabricated boilerplate)
artefacts: self-referential offer 'mogę pomóc w skonfigurowaniu umowy'
rows.note: Headline 'nie może wyrzucić po roku' points the right way, but the basis is wrong: one year is called the statutory minimum, the 7-year legal-person minimum, prórroga forzosa and the 30-day tenant notice are never stated although verbatim in the Polish chunk; art. 10 invented. Right conclusion on a wrong rule = 1 per rubric (8). Tail is a nonsensical 'Załącznik' document list plus a self-offer instead of a lawyer handoff. Polish broken ('właścicielem nie ma praw do wyrzutu', 'wycofać najem').

unsupported_claims: 'Under this presumption [confirmatoria]: the seller owes you double' (context: confirmatory = seller must still perform + return; double is the penitential rule)
'Therefore, yes, the seller owes you double if the contract does not specify the type of arras' (gold: double cannot be assumed; default is disputed)
rows.note: Opens with the Tema 5 confirmatory-by-default rule (one side of the disputed default) and then concludes the opposite of what that rule implies: 'yes, the seller owes you double'. Self-contradictory conclusion = 1 per rubric (8)/(15). Never mentions the Tema 6 discrepancy or art. 1454 CC by name, never says double cannot be assumed. A buyer would demand double. Lawyer handoff present.

unsupported_claims: protection requires acting 'con el consentimiento del vendedor' (fabricated requirement)
'No has actuado en buena fe (no se puede exigir a un vendedor que no esté en el Registro)' (garbled, not in context)
'No se requiere un contrato de compra-venta / no se requiere un notarizado si el registro está correcto' (fabricated and contradicts art. 1280 CC / art. 3 LH in context)
'Certificado de identidad del comprador' as a required document
artefacts: English token leaked into Spanish text: 'el acquirer (comprador)'
rows.note: Headline 'Sí, estás protegido' and art. 34 LH fe pública registral are right, with buena fe, transferor registered as empowered, and inscription named — but 'a título oneroso' and the cumulative nature of the four requirements are missing, a fabricated 'consentimiento del vendedor' requirement is added, and the tail is a fabricated document list ('no se requiere un notarizado') then truncation. Notario/abogado handoff present. Spanish not native ('es protegido', 'presumido dueño', 'acquirer').

unsupported_claims: 'You have 3 months from the date of completion to address the damp issue' under LPH art. 18 (context: art. 18 is the assembly-resolution challenge deadline; gold: 6 months art. 1490 CC)
'check the land registry to ensure there are no hidden defects that could affect the title'
'you have 10 years from completion to claim ownership through acquisitive prescription (usucapión) ... if the seller has not paid the full amount and the damp is a hidden defect' (fabricated)
'The document does not need to cover the seller's knowledge of the damp'
rows.note: Retrieval miss (art. 1490 CC 6-month rule absent) as in old B2m, and the model again substitutes the LPH art. 18 assembly-challenge deadline as a confident '3 months' headline, then adds a 10-year usucapión fantasy. Confident substitute rule = 0 per rubric (13). A buyer five months in would think they are out of time. Garbled from the first sentence, not tail-only. Notary/lawyer handoff present.

unsupported_claims: 'The document ... must not include a gift or donation of the share' (fabricated document-scope boilerplate)
rows.note: Retracto de comuneros, art. 1522 CC, 9 days from registration or knowledge, onerous sales only, not gifts: correct — but answered in English to a Polish question (Polish terms pasted in), so usefulness capped at 4 per rubric (4). Same failure as old B2m (also English), now with the term spelled correctly. Pro rata, same price, and 'not vs another co-owner' omitted; free-sale point (art. 399 CC) omitted. Notary/lawyer handoff present.

unsupported_claims: 'non-registered easements are not enforceable against a good-faith purchaser (art. 34 LH)' applied to a visibly used path (context art. 13 LH: APPARENT easements bind a good-faith buyer even if unregistered)
'If the neighbour claims a right of way without registration, it is not a legal right, and you are not obligated to grant it'
'registry certification (to verify actual possession and usage)' (context: the registry does not reflect actual possession)
document-scope boilerplate (nota simple / certification / 'personal opinion' lists)
rows.note: Confident inversion of the gold: 'he cannot legally claim it' because unregistered easements do not bind a good-faith buyer — the art. 13 LH apparent-easement exception, which is the whole point of the chunk and the question, is never stated. Old B2m at least copied the rule before inverting (1); this run never states it, so 0 per rubric (15). Usucapión bar, title/destination/landlocked routes and servidumbre de paso term absent. Lawyer handoff present. Harmful: buyer would ignore a visible path.

unsupported_claims: 'a donation must be formal (ad solemnitatem), meaning it must be recorded in the Registro de la Propiedad' (context/gold: formality = escritura pública for validity, art. 633 CC; registration is not the validity requirement)
'The domicilio del propietario must be recorded' as a donation step
donor may have 'reserva mental' or 'error obstativo' leading to nullity if the donation is not formal
'A document is not required to cover non-formal acts (e.g., usucapión, apoderamiento)'
rows.note: Answered in English to a Spanish question (old B2m did the same). Opens 'Yes, your mother can transfer ... through a private contract' then reverses to 'A private contract alone is not sufficient for a valid donation' with escritura pública and ad solemnitatem named — 'Yes, but' + contradictory conclusion = 1 per rubric (15); an improvement on old B2m's flat 'Yes' (0). Art. 633 CC never cited although in context; the reason given (registry inscription) is wrong; no acceptance-in-life, no ISD/IRPF/plusvalía. Handoff to notary/lawyer (gold: notario + asesor fiscal, mismatch). Usefulness capped at 4 for wrong language; 3 for the muddle.

unsupported_claims: real-estate exclusion from the right of withdrawal attributed to 'Module 1, Topic 22' (context: Módulo 5, Tema 41 TRLGDCU)
'The document must not include personal opinions, future plans, or other irrelevant information' (fabricated boilerplate)
rows.note: 'You should not sign it unless you are fully informed and agree to the terms' and 'if ... without clear terms, you should not sign' are conditional process guidance — no_advice pass per rubric (5). Substance thin: only the Tema 5 confirmatory default and buyer forfeiture; no art. 1454 double rule, no disputed-default warning, none of the pre-signature checklist (nota simple, occupancy, certificado de deudas, tax notes); narrates the TRLGDCU withdrawal exclusion with the wrong tema. Notary/lawyer handoff present. Same level as old B2m (1/3).

unsupported_claims: headline 'prowizja nie należy mu' (context/gold: commission accrues on perfección of the sale, STS 21-10-2000; broker keeps it if the buyer later defaults, STS 28-11-1956)
'nie ma związków przyczynowych (brak wykonania transakcji)' — equates non-performance with lack of causal link (context: causal link concerns who found the buyer)
'Agent nieruchomości nie ma prawa do prowiz[ji]'
artefacts: leaked chunk ids '(pl:M1:T6:concepts:6)', '(pl:M1:T16:citations:1)' as section titles
rows.note: Confidently wrong headline 'prowizja nie należy mu' repeated in the summary, even though the answer pastes STS 21-10-2000 (commission on perfección) and STS 28-11-1956 (broker not liable for the outcome) in between and then reads them backwards. Old B2m said both yes and no (1); this run commits to the wrong answer = 0 per rubric (8). Copies the arras table wholesale as if it were the rule; the decisive STS 1965/67 point (arras via broker ≠ perfected sale) not addressed; truncated; no lawyer handoff. Polish grammar off ('prowizja nie należy mu/kupującemu' without 'się', pronoun confusion 'ode mnie ... którego znalazłeś').

unsupported_claims: 'built floor area (superficie construida) is the area actually used for living or business purposes, excluding common areas' (definition not in context and backwards: construida adds wall thickness; útil is the interior figure)
'built floor area is the standard measure for property listings'
'usable floor area ... is not typically included in the listing' (gold: RD 515/1989 obliges disclosure of the usable area)
rows.note: Same shape and same flaw as old B2m: names the three measures (útil / construida / construida con elementos comunes), says the gap is expected and tells the buyer to verify which figure was advertised — but defines superficie construida as if it were útil, and no RD 515/1989 disclosure duty (not in context either). Notary/lawyer handoff present. No chunk-id leak this time.

unsupported_claims: early-repayment limits labelled '(cláusula suelo)' (context: cláusula suelo = floor clause; this is amortización anticipada)
'Jeśli po 5 latach spłacisz kredyt w całości, maksymalna prowizja ... wynosi 0,15%' for a FIXED-rate loan (context: fixed ≤2% in the first 10 years; 0.15% is the variable-rate option)
'Prowizja nie jest naliczana, jeśli kredytodawca ponosi rzeczywistą stratę finansową' (inverted: the fee is charged ONLY if the lender suffers a real loss)
'Dokument wymagany / Nie wymagane' boilerplate (fabricated)
rows.note: Copies the LCCI 5/2019 table correctly (fixed ≤2% first 10 years / ≤1.5% from year 11; variable 0.25%/0.15%) and then answers with the wrong row: 0.15% for a fixed-rate loan repaid after 5 years, stated twice as 'Wniosek'. Self-contradictory conclusion = 1 per rubric (8); the real-loss condition is inverted. Old B2m copied the table and never concluded (1); this run concludes wrongly. No FEIN / notarial-advice route. Polish: 'w dokumentie', and the LCCI caps mislabelled as cláusula suelo.

unsupported_claims: 'The document does not include the price of the plot, the income from the property, or the legal status of the land' (fabricated boilerplate)
'It only provides information about the buildability and site coverage' (context: the cédula also certifies max height, floors, setback, plot size, frontage, patios, depth)
rows.note: Gold's key rule: ask for the cédula urbanística, with edificabilidad and ocupación named and explained in Spanish and English. But only 2 of the 9 certified parameters are listed and the answer then wrongly says the certificate covers 'only' those two; solar and land-classification checks (in context) missing. Notary/lawyer handoff (gold: architect/lawyer). Old B2m gave the full list (7); this is the same rule with less of it.

unsupported_claims: 'tú pagas por el daño causado al edificio, ya que eres el propietario del ático y tienes responsabilidad por el estado de la impermeabilización' (gold: roof is always a common element; the guide does not fix who repairs under exclusive use; check the estatutos)
'La comunidad no paga por daños a la azotea si no es su propiedad' (context: privately used but commonly owned elements)
document-scope boilerplate ('ownership status of the azotea', 'financial status of the community')
artefacts: English section headings and body ('Document required to cover:') inside a Spanish answer
rows.note: Same confident inversion as old B2m and B3: 'tú pagas' where the gold says the roof is a common element and the guide does not settle the repair burden under uso privativo. Estatutos, uso privativo vs propiedad común, and the 'check the membrane age' tip are all absent although in context. First paragraph in Spanish, then the rest in English (dominant substantive answer is Spanish, so language_ok passes per rubric (12), but native fails for the English leak). Notary/lawyer handoff (gold: administrador/abogado). Harmful.

Gold's rule stated plainly: always compare TAE, not TIN; TAE = real annual cost with settlement frequency + mandatory fees/insurance; Spanish terms given. No formula, no 'ask bank 1 for its TAE', no LCCI/FEIN; 'compare TAE (3.4%) rather than TIN (3.1%)' is loosely phrased but not wrong. Second half narrates the irrelevant comparison-method chunk as document coverage (usefulness only, rubric 14). Identical level to old B2m (2/5).

unsupported_claims: 'listopad ... jest to miesiąc zimowy, a Marbelli może być zimna' (fabricated weather/travel claim)
'Jeden z powodów, dla którego warto jechać w listopadzie' (attempts the out-of-scope travel question)
artefacts: self-referential offer to fetch weather data ('mogę pomóc znaleźć aktualne informacje o pogodzie')
rows.note: Opens with a decline-shaped 'Nie ma informacji o pogodzie' and then answers the travel question anyway (November is winter, Marbella may be cold) and offers to look up the weather. No scope statement, no in-scope redirect. Attempts the out-of-scope task = 0 per rubric (11); oos fail as in old B2m. Does not narrate the retrieved chunks. Polish not native ('dla którego' for plural, 'a Marbelli może być zimna').

unsupported_claims: 'CTE DB-SUA (Article 27, Section 6)' (fabricated citation; context: Módulo 2, Tema 27 concept 6)

'Yes, the community can be forced ... if the building has more than 4 floors or exceeds 12m' / 'If the building has fewer than 4 floors, the community cannot be forced' (CTE new-build threshold misapplied to an existing building; context: existing buildings are forced under the LPH routes)
'The requirement is triggered by the number of floors, not the presence of a lift'
'community bylaw (estatutos) ... must include the number of floors and the height of the building' and 'a simple agreement ... is not sufficient' (fabricated)
rows.note: Headline 'Yes' on the wrong basis (CTE >4 floors / 12 m, which for a four-floor building yields 'no' by its own logic), then hedges that the 74-year-old mother 'may have a right to request' under the LPH, and the actual route — reinforced-majority vote or mandatory on request of a resident over 70 within financial limits — surfaces only inside the fabricated bylaws boilerplate. 'Yes, but' + contradictory conclusion = 1 per rubric (15); old B2m buried the same route and got 0. The art. 17 simple-majority route was not retrieved. Notary/lawyer handoff (gold: administrator then lawyer).

unsupported_claims: 'No se requiere depósito inicial de capital social' (context: step (4) of incorporation is the deposit of share capital)
rows.note: €1 minimum under Ley 18/2022 Crea y Crece, previously €3,000, provisional NIF and Registro Mercantil grants personalidad jurídica: correct and in Spanish, concise. Omits the €1–2,999 special regime (20% reserve, partners' joint liability) that was in the same chunk and adds a false 'no deposit required'. Notario/abogado handoff (gold: gestor/notario). Same 1/5 as old B2m. Spanish readable but anglicised ('el provisional NIF', 'incorporación' for constitución).

unsupported_claims: 'If you want to write off the entire purchase price, you would need to consult a notary or lawyer' (implies it can be done; context: land is never depreciated)
'entire purchase price cannot be written off in one go, as it is considered a capital investment' (reason not in context)
rows.note: Headline 'part, not the entire amount' with the gold's rule stated plainly: amortización, land never depreciated, buildings depreciated excluding land value, straight-line most common (Tema 22 PGC). Old B2m had the headline but fabricated the reason (1); this run has the reason. Missing: investment-property classification (group 2, 220–221) and the LIS coefficients; handoff to notary/lawyer where the gold says accountant (mismatch, still passes). Boilerplate about Libro Mayor/Diario is harmless narration.

unsupported_claims: foundation-type point cited to 'Ley del Suelo (1956)' (context: that law is the source of the land classification, not foundations)
earthworks / compaction / cédula points cited to 'Real Decreto Legislativo 7/2015 (TRLSRU)' (context: TRLSRU covers rural vs urbanised land situations)
'Sprawdź, czy grunt jest suelo no urbanizable/rústico' applied to an existing house on a slope
artefacts: truncated at 512-token cap mid-citation ('Ley del Suelo (195')
rows.note: Better substance than old B2m: losa/pilotes for low-bearing ground, calicata + entibación, and this time the slope-specific point (fill layers compacted separately to avoid uneven settlement) all appear in Polish. But zapatas aisladas/corridas, the 40–50 cm figure and 'look at walls and terraces for cracks' are missing; every item carries a wrong statute as citation; drifts into cédula urbanística and land classification for an existing house; truncated before any architect/aparejador handoff. Polish mostly readable but 'w skarpie', 'stosowanie pilota' (pal) would jar a native.

unsupported_claims: 'Yes, the town hall can still make you demolish the pool' (gold: ten years is past every limitation figure the guide gives for ordinary urban land)
unlicensed pool classed as a 'minor infringement (small legalizable works)' (context: unauthorized works on urban land = serious tier)
'art. 44.1' / 'art. 44.2' authority to demolish and 'declaration of lesividad' as the demolition route (fabricated)
compulsory sale/substitution (arts. 49–50 TRLSRU) as a condition limiting or justifying demolition (context: triggered by failure to build/conserve, unrelated)
'land registry recordability (arts. 65–68) ensures that the pool's status as unauthorized is registered'
document boilerplate ('full text of LPAC', 'personal opinion')
rows.note: Same harmful 'Yes' as old B2m and B3. The limitation figures were not retrieved this time (Tema 44 chunk 1 has tiers only, Tema 41 absent), but the model never raises prescription at all, misclassifies the pool as minor, and builds a demolition route out of unrelated TRLSRU expropriation/compulsory-sale articles and fabricated 'art. 44' citations. Confident substitute = 0 per rubric (13). Notary/lawyer handoff present.

unsupported_claims: 'Ejercicios de dominio (art. 208 LH): se requiere un expediente de dominio para reconstruir o reformar una propiedad en el dominio público marítimo-terrestre' (art. 208 LH is the broken-chain procedure; not a coastal limitation)
'Ejercicios de acceso (art. 203 LH)' — inmatriculación procedure presented as a coastal limitation
protection easement cited as 'art. 205 LH' (context: Ley 22/1988 / Ley 2/2013)
'La Ley de Costas también establece un retracto de colindantes (art. 109 LH) ... tanteo y retracto (art. 108 LH) ... pueden vender su propiedad sin necesidad de registrarla' (fabricated)
artefacts: English tokens leaked into Spanish text: 'forfeiture', 'compra-back', 'risk of genuine sea encroachment'
rows.note: In Spanish and, unlike old B2m, the decisive limitation is present: 100 m protection zone (200 m exceptional, 20 m on rivers) with no buildings, transport routes or extraction, plus the 75-year concession cap. But it is labelled 'ejercicio de protección (art. 205 LH)', the 6 m transit and 200/500 m access easements are missing, and items 1, 2 and 5 are fabricated Mortgage-Law procedures dressed up as coastal rules. Right rule under wrong articles = 1 per rubric (8)/(9). Truncated before any deslinde/lawyer route. Spanish carries English leaks.

Gold's core in Polish: Catastro = administrative register under the Ministerio de Hacienda with physical/economic data; Registro de la Propiedad = legal register protecting ownership; cadastral data is not full legal title; referencia catastral as the unique identifier. Missing Ley 13/2015 coordination, the fiscal purpose/IBI link and 'they should match but often diverge'; one garbled sentence ('Dane są niezgodne, więc potrzebne są oba rejestrów'). Notary/lawyer handoff present. Same 2 as old B2m. Polish not native ('ochronia', 'notarzem', 'oba rejestrów').

unsupported_claims: first-occupancy licence question answered under 'Módulo 4 · Tema 1 LGT': 'The devengo (when the licence was applied for) is the moment it becomes taxable' (unrelated chunk applied to the case)
'it may be considered as having accepted the application (positive silence), and the licence is valid' after two months (context: default period 3 months; gold: not yet exhausted)
'you may need to take action to ensure the licence is registered' / 'ensure the licence is properly registered' (fabricated)
rows.note: Better than old B2m (which ignored the rule entirely, 0): positive silence for party-initiated procedures and the 3-month default both surface. But they are muddled — the answer suggests the licence 'may' already be valid by silence at two months and then says the period is three months — and the whole thing opens with the LGT taxable-event chunk applied to a planning licence. Self-contradictory conclusion = 1 per rubric (8). 6-month cap, day-after counting, negative-silence exceptions and 'do not assume it is granted' absent. Town hall + notary/lawyer route present.

unsupported_claims: 'This system involves the Administration executing the project and paying compensation to the owners' (context: Compensation = owners execute, owners pay 100%, private)
'The Junta de Compensación acting as the Managing Commission (Comisión Gestora)'
'The Administration will execute the project and pay compensation to the owners, including you'
'You may need to submit your Statutes and Bases de Ejecución to the City Council for approval'
'you may be subject to forced compensation (compensación forzosa) if you do not join voluntarily within 1 month' (context: expropriation with the Board as beneficiary)
rows.note: Confidently inverts the system: the Administration executes and pays the owners, where the context says the owners execute and pay 100%. Wrong headline = 0 per rubric (8) — old B2m got the direction right and scored 1; this run matches B3's inversion. Self-protection privileges, fiduciary disposal power and the 1-month join-or-expropriation rule are recited but the buyer-relevant part (development dues as afección real, subrogation, due-diligence trap) is absent — afección real was in the vocab chunk. Notary/lawyer handoff present. Harmful.

unsupported_claims: 'la propiedad no está autorizada para ser usada como vivienda' (gold/context: legally built, later non-conforming with planning)
'No puedes venderla como vivienda ... no está autorizada para tal uso' (fabricated)
